title: Headless article JSON and publish events for host sites
description: Backlog. Per-article JSON (front matter fields plus the rendered body fragment) and a full index next to _data/latest.json, plus an event (EventBridge or webhook) when an article is published, changed or removed, so a server-rendered host app can render articles in its own components and revalidate only those pages. Alternative to mounting with a base path. Gherkin to be written when picked up.
